record.body:
## Rationale

Eight stage names do not fit a 60 column header; the stepper word keeps the stage visible at a glance.

## Counter-argument

A strip on the header shows progress through the loop without opening the phase.

payload.alternatives: The full strip on the phase header row in the main table
payload.choice: The full stage strip is in phase detail; the stepper shows only the current stage word

record.subject: stage-strip-placement
